lines: Don’t have more fun than when you’re with me
It’s fine that you, wounded at heart, are like this
You’re good at making me uneasy
I want a love that can’t speak well
Don’t be polished, just try breaking me
Even the crucial title remains forgotten
The record I spun over and over
It piled up and was hidden
Even today the earth is pure white
I closed my eyes
I don’t want to know
The live feed between that girl and him
It’s burned into my eyes
Because I learned to nod in agreement
The temperature I turned away
And the data that announces the end
Swallowing code and oxygen
Even I, now, am weightless
I’m tired of goodnights and apologies
I have to say it, but I still don’t want to
Because nothing will start otherwise
If I don’t say it, I’ll just stay as I am
Pretending not to notice
Is it okay if we just play at it
Even if it’s crooked, it’s fine
I’ll keep shining today as well
Even if you never notice at the end
Jupiter and the moon must be pierced through
Unattainable love can’t be touched
Just a little of the world you live in
When I finally came around and got close
I listened closely to your trembling voice
Don’t reply just because it’s awkward
Even this distance can be crossed
I can’t stay so confident
Even promises to meet
Are just about timing
Your scent, too
Had changed before I knew it
I have to cross it, not run away
I keep only pretending to think that
If we don’t meet, we won’t hear
You try to look away
I’ve always been aware
Even if it’s crooked, it’s fine
I’ll keep shining today as well
Even if you never notice at the end
Jupiter and the moon must be pierced through
Unattainable voice can’t be touched
Just a little of the world you live in
When I finally came around and got close
You were the first
To find me, I want
Even though I can’t say it
Are you still awake?
Who are you looking at today?
Why am I shining for you?
The sun and the moon must be pierced through
Unattainable love can’t be touched
Just a little of the world you live in
When I finally came around and got close
I listened closely to your trembling voice
Don’t reply just because it’s awkward
Even this distance can be crossed
I won’t cause you any trouble
